In this section from *web books meditations13 section0026 html 2f1654*, the master explains: *"[Section: A Trained Observer] We had a visitor the other day who made a strange comment: that my approach to insight followed Majjhima 64."*. From the perspective of the Four Noble Truths, suffering arises whenever the mind grasps at impermanent phenomena (*anicca*) as a reliable self (*atta*). Anchor your understanding in direct seeing rather than speculative theory.
